Women’s Black Oversized Printed T-Shirt – Caribbean Girl Design

Add a fun, tropical touch to your everyday wardrobe with this stylish women’s oversized T-shirt. Featuring a vibrant Caribbean-inspired print with tropical elements, this black T-shirt offers a relaxed oversized fit that is perfect for casual and streetwear looks.

Key Features:

Stylish tropical Caribbean-inspired print
Premium-looking black base
Comfortable oversized/relaxed fit
Soft and breathable feel
Round neck
Short sleeves
Lightweight and easy to wear
Suitable for casual outings, vacations, travel and everyday wear
Easy to pair with jeans, shorts, joggers or skirts
Modern trendy women’s fashion

Color: Black
Print: Caribbean Girl / Tropical Graphic
Fit: Oversized / Relaxed Fit
